written_results: Distance-eight graph is folded cube of order nine, with odd girth nine; all at-most-eight induced subgraphs are bipartite.
A connected k-point support for k<=8 embeds with retained generator labels in an ordinary cube of dimension at most k-1.
Explicit eight-position matrix has nonzero ternary-RHS integer solution of amplitude21; unbounded exclusion is false.
For that eight-position matrix, all ternary-RHS integer solutions are zero or the two amplitude21 character solutions; bounded9 excludes them.
Every entire-support distance-eight star with one to seven leaves has only the zero integer solution.
Explicit Q3 and Q5 counterexamples exclude a dimension-uniform minimum equal to n.
limits: Walsh classification, star proof and geometry are written, without new Lean assembly.
Prepared Lean source checks only the literal eight-point oversized matrix witness; parent controls compilation.
No binary-selection counterexample or longer snake.

primary_precedent.title: Cores of Cubelike Graphs
primary_precedent.verified_content: Folded cube has unique full-generator relation and odd girth n for odd n.
